Companion Animal Travel Desk reply to your complaint

We understand that you and Benny were affected by a delayed departure, and you’re upset because your companion animal plans did not unfold as smoothly as expected.

First, thank you for taking the time to let the Companion Animal Travel Desk know what happened. Aurelia Skyways carries passengers between skyports, and our crew is guided to treat companion animals with care from check-in through boarding. Our department also works closely with crew so that travel is coordinated and any risks to animal comfort and safety are addressed quickly and calmly.

Regarding the delayed departure, please know that incident handling is not optional and it is tracked end-to-end. <<FACT F109>> This is the standard payout for the incident, and it is processed according to the incident category attached to your booking and travel record.

We also want to reassure you on what we can control during disruption. When a delay occurs, our companion animal travel process focuses on three things: keeping the animal’s stress level as low as possible, maintaining appropriate care conditions, and making sure the next available segment is communicated clearly. Companion animal instructions are shared with the relevant crew so they can respond consistently and respectfully, especially with animals that are traveling as part of a passenger’s household.

If you experienced communication gaps, that is something we take seriously. Aurelia Skyways expects prompt, respectful communication, and we will review the handling steps associated with your journey to confirm that the guidance provided to staff matched our usual standards. If you have any additional details you can share about what you observed, such as how long you waited at the skyport or whether Benny needed any particular accommodation, that will help the senior coordinator document what went wrong and where the process can be improved.

Aya Andersson and Gabriel Lee (travelers) are welcome to provide any supporting notes, and we’ll ensure the record is updated before payout is finalized. If you already submitted an inquiry through our channels, please allow the normal processing window for the standard payout to post to the method associated with your booking.

Thanks again for your patience. We hope Benny is now settled and safe, and we’re here if anything else comes up.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
